newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ATHLETICS-ROMANIA'S NEGURA BANNED FOR DRUG USE.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-ROMANIA'S NEGURA BANNED FOR DRUG USE.

text.p: Romania's athletics federation said on Wednesday it had banned European cross country champion Iulia Negura for two years for failing a doping test last November.
"The Romanian Athletics Federation has banned Iulia Negura from all national and international competitions for a two-year period, dating from December 4 1996," the Federation said in a statement.
Negura, 30, tested positive for the anabolic steroid stanozolol.

Negura, considered Romania's most prominent international athlete in recent years, denied taking banned substances. The positive test, confirmed by a second sample, prompted the resignation of the national long distance athletics coach Dorin Melinte.

"Both Iulia Negura and her trainer Dorin Melinte say she took no banned substances," the Federation statement said. "If such substances were found in samples, this could be due to a malicious act for which, unfortunately, they have no evidence for the moment."

Federation president Iolanda Balas told Reuters officials had limited the ban to two years, instead of four years as stipulated by the International Amateur Athletic Federation, as the offence was Negura's first in a long career. REUTER
